candidates.label: Proven glass-cannon (flat 20-46) — re-anchor the all-time best operating point
candidates.rationale: Re-seed the historically best band (true-glass-cannon 20-46 scored 0.681 two cycles ago, beating the 16-38 tighter mutant at 0.660). Confirms ~20px is the sweet spot and re-establishes the score anchor for this cycle's island evolution.

candidates.label: Micro-mutation: 23-50 — probe just outside the 20-46 optimum
candidates.rationale: Island micro-mutation of the 0.681 anchor, nudging the band out 3px (23-50). Last cycle 16-38 (tighter) scored LOWER than 20-46, so this tests the other direction of the gradient to confirm 20-46 is a true local max, not a plateau edge.

candidates.label: Mid-tempo bruiser — 50-90 hold, dash to 30 only on a ready skill
candidates.rationale: Targets a mid-engage / mid-tempo cell distinct from the two glass-cannon-ish elites. A fighter that holds a 50-90 bruiser band and only lunges to contact (30-60) when Q or E is ready — a pulsing cadence that should read as a different tempo descriptor than the flat always-hug winner.

candidates.label: All-in-when-hurt — kite at full HP, dive point-blank below 50%
candidates.rationale: Inverts the usual retreat-on-low-HP: cautious 90-150 kite while healthy, then a desperate 18-44 all-in once HP<50% to end the fight before dying. Should push the durability descriptor DOWN a bin (the archive is stuck at dur bin3) by deliberately trading HP in the low-HP phase.

candidates.label: Fixed sniper — flat 240-330, never close, never flee (farthest non-passive)
candidates.rationale: Pushes the engage axis to its LOW extreme: a disciplined 240-330 max-range poke that still commits output (ranged, not the do-nothing control). Aims to open an engage-bin-0 cell the archive lacks, distinct from the 2,2,3 patient-sniper by sitting even farther out.
